Go 1.22, the standard library and the modules named at the end (go.mod requires them; the build runs with GOPROXY=off). gofmt-formatted (gofmt -l prints nothing) and go vet clean. A file's package is its directory's base name; exported names in MixedCaps; a package imports another of the module by the module path of go.mod + "/" + its directory. Tests are `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` in the package's own `_test.go` files, table tests allowed; compare with `testhelp.Equal(t, what, got, want)` of the module's `internal/testhelp`, never your own helper; no t.Skip, no network, no clock, no goroutine left running. Imports: the standard library plus github.com/google/go-cmp@v0.7.0, golang.org/x/text@v0.21.0; their API is in docs/deps/go-cmp.md; no other import.
